scope: Preliminary consistency review of all four 16-image contact sheets, selected original-resolution PNGs, and scenes.py functions evaporation/suction/friction/bridge. No production PASS issued. No other reader scores were accessed.

findings.observation: At cue 05 (k=4), time=min(1,(k+p)/4) is already 1 for every progress value, so the book is stationary at x=486. The same shot labels Energy during the slide while the kinetic-energy bar decreases and thermal-energy bar increases. Both PNGs show identical book position despite different motion-energy levels.
findings.implication: The viewer sees a resting book retaining substantial kinetic energy and continuing to convert it to heat. The animation's state contradicts its own explanation of kinetic energy during sliding.
findings.requested_change: Replay the actual sliding phase explicitly and synchronize book speed/position and kinetic-energy share during cue 05, or move the energy-transfer graphic into the actual sliding interval. If a separate time axis is intentional, label and visually separate it as a replay instead of placing it over an apparently current stationary book.
findings.verification_needed: Regenerate cue 05 original-resolution pairs after the code change, inspect book motion versus kinetic-energy share, and bind any production review to the revised renderer and exact prepared inputs.

findings.observation: The pressure demonstration uses selected downward outside and upward inside pressure-force arrows; cue 05 explicitly calls them selected vertical pressure forces.
findings.implication: This is a useful selected-component comparison. It should not be presented later as a full directional distribution of air pressure or a complete contact-force diagram.
findings.requested_change: Retain selected-force/schematic framing in production; keep the sealed cavity, nonzero trapped-air markers and rim-opening path visible.
findings.verification_needed: Check prepared cue text and final rendered transitions for the press/seal/rebound/open order. No scientific defect identified in the sampled opening and pressure frames.

findings.observation: The still-air inset has opposing arrows, the breeze inset carries schematic vapor markers laterally out of the crop, and equal-starting-shirt conditions are labeled. Cue 07 resets wetness while explicitly saying Matched shirts at the start.
findings.implication: No currently visible claim that water disappears or that wetness spontaneously returns without a comparison reset. The condition labels and symbol identification are doing necessary explanatory work.
findings.requested_change: Keep Water molecule symbols, schematic context, same room humidity, and matched-at-start labels readable in production. Do not treat marker counts or shrinking blue patches as measured evaporation rates.
findings.verification_needed: Confirm final animation preserves continuous lateral marker motion, and the reset-to-start comparison is understandable when heard with the actual cue timing.

findings.observation: The left deck endpoint advances as warm increases, the reference deck and supports stay fixed, the gap narrows/widens correctly relative to the displayed warm/cool state, and the movement is labeled exaggerated. The stress example is a separate inset.
findings.implication: The sampled geometry supports the stated simplified expansion-joint explanation without implying that the whole bridge translates or piers stretch.
findings.requested_change: Retain fixed-reference, sliding-bearing and exaggerated-movement labels; do not present the illustrated displacement as a measured thermal coefficient or a universal bridge layout.
findings.verification_needed: Check the exact prepared animation for continuity across warm-to-cool transition and inspect encoded output before final acceptance.

not_verified: Exact prepared input manifest, narration/audio, timing, source bundle, fonts, helpers and tool bindings were not supplied for this review.
The contact sheets sample all cue pairs, but only selected original PNGs were opened at full size; continuous animation and every transition remain unverified.
No MP4 was decoded or inspected, and caption bounds, audio, mobile readability and human viewing outcomes were not evaluated.
This review identifies internal visual consistency issues and production conditions; it is not a new full literature-based fact audit of episodes 13–16.
next_gate: Prepare exact inputs only after required script reviews are available; fix episode 15 chronology, regenerate affected evidence, and obtain a new review bound to actual prepared bytes. Do not turn this draft findings file into a PASS by refreshing hashes.
